title: People running on treadmills at the gym
notes: Gym interior with a row of treadmills; a woman (soft-focus foreground, profile) and a man (mid-shot, face visible in profile) running. Faces do not fill the frame, but they are clearly not the protagonist. BRIGHT daytime gym, so darken and warm it. No brand marks visible on the consoles; TV screens in the background show only images. FILE IS 1280x720: mk.py only reaches the 720p asset for this newer item, though the clip page offers a 1080p download. Group C st60 uses the same clip at 4.0-7.0 s; this in-point (0.5-3.5 s) does not overlap. Every other Free treadmill clip checked (49276, 47877, 47879, 49501, 21698) is Restricted.

title: Sleeping boy moves in bed
notes: Dark blue night bedroom: a person lies curled under the duvet with only the top of the head (sleep mask) showing. The duvet settles 4.6-5.4 s, then he is still to the end (8.1 s). No face, no text. Dark tone, usable as is. Same actor as st04/05 (31412).

title: Girl using her cell phone in her bed waiting to sleep
notes: Dark room, top-of-head view: a short-black-haired person in a dark top lies on their back with eyes closed, completely still, arms raised out of the top of the frame. The face is upside down and partly visible, not prominent. Androgynous look, close to the protagonist's styling. No phone or text visible in this section (the phone use happens before 9 s). Dark tone, usable as is. Same actor as st16 and st17/19.

title: Boy puts his cell phone aside so he can go to sleep
notes: Night bedroom in blue light: a young man (Black, pink tank top) half-lying in bed, scrolling a phone held in both hands. Medium shot; his face is visible but does not fill the frame. Phone back shows only the camera module, no legible brand. The wall has line-drawing art, no text. Dark tone. Shares the clip with st05 (0.0-1.4 here, 1.5-6.1 there, no overlap).

title: Boy puts his cell phone aside so he can go to sleep
notes: Continues st04: he keeps scrolling (1.5-3.5 s), stops and looks off to the side as if thinking (~4.1 s), then turns to put the phone on the nightstand (5.6-6.1 s). This fits 'then suddenly'. Blurred under the centre subtitle. No text or logo. Group B may also use 31412 (it was downloaded by another agent) but not for a neighbouring segment.

title: Man playing guitar in the dark
notes: Hands only: an acoustic guitar body with sound hole, a strumming hand and a fretting hand in a dark room. Black-and-white, so the editor may warm-tint it. He forms chords (slow, calm), not just touching the strings. No headstock or brand visible. No Free clip of a guitar standing alone was found (11808 and 17285 are Restricted).

title: A young student woman picks a book from the library shelf
notes: Warm, dim bookshelf: a hand (white sweater sleeve) slides along the book spines with shallow focus; no face. BLUR NEEDED: the in-focus spines next to the hand are legible at 1080p (WHY CIVIL RESISTANCE, PSICOLOGIA, DESEO, EL NUDO DEL SILENCIO, BARON, HANDWRITING), plus small red shelf stickers. Apply a light blur (~6-8) to the right half or the whole frame. Background spines are already out of focus. 50726 (hand running across spines, burnout) has even more legible titles. Alt 50723 is a wide bookstore shot with no legible titles but no clear book-taking.

title: Man dressed in suit crossing the street
notes: Tracking shot from behind: a man in a navy suit walks along a city street towards a building at dusk, with a green pedestrian light. Back of head only, no face. Reads as a walk home after work. Fairly bright overcast dusk, so darken it towards evening. No signs or readable text in frame. No Free clip of someone walking home at night from behind was found (21371, 33034 and 23410 are Restricted; 40640 is too dark; 4451 has readable shop signs).

title: Sad and desperate man lying on a sofa
notes: PARTIAL match: shows the after-collapse state, not the flop itself. A man sprawled on a grey sofa, forearm over his eyes, exhausted; his face is partly hidden by the arm. Grey daylight with a moody tone; darken slightly. No text. The literal collapse onto a bed (25596) is used for st15, which sits between protagonist photos and needs the face hidden. Group C st52 uses 25579 at 8.6-13.1 s; this in-point (4.5-8.0 s) does not overlap.

title: Young man working in an office overtime
notes: Dark office at night: a young man in a white shirt and tie loosens up and rubs his eye under his glasses (7.1-8.4 s) at his desk; the background is office lights and a glass-block wall. Face visible (side and three-quarter), partly covered by his hand. No logos or text in range. Dark tone, usable as is. Most other tired-office clips (5601, 33259, 14650, 24063, 29961, 5595) are Restricted.

title: Sad girl sitting on the floor
notes: Dim blue-grey bedroom: a young woman sits alone on the floor against the bed, hugging her knees, head tilted back, staring blankly upward (1.2-6.2 s). Full-body side view; her face is in profile and small. No text. Dark and moody, fits 'nothing left'. From 8.8 s she covers her face; do not go past 6.5 s.

title: Writing notes at a cafe
notes: Hands only (a man's hands, black T-shirt sleeve): writing steadily in a small flip notepad next to an iced coffee on a wooden tray. The writing is not legible. No logos. BRIGHT white table, not lamp-lit, so darken and warm it towards a desk-lamp look. Chosen over 99890/99909 (burnout to-do-list clips) because group C uses those for st59/st62. No Free lamp-lit list-writing clip was found (16139, 46768, 46559, 45148 and 48607 are Restricted).

title: Analog wall clock on a black background in a closed socket
notes: Close-up of a white wall clock on black; the second hand sweeps from 11 past 12. No brand on the dial. Dark surround, usable as is. Note: the hands read about 1:00, not an evening hour. Alt 28893 is closer with an ambiguous time.

title: Student draws a mathematical chart over a squared notebook with a book on the side
notes: PARTIAL match: hands only under warm desk light. The left hand smooths a squared notebook open while the right hand starts writing with a pen; an open textbook is at the lower left. It shows starting to study, not literally opening the book. The notebook has small printed headers and pencil geometry; nothing legible at a glance. No face. Warm and slightly dim, usable. Avoid the arm that crosses the frame after 7.6 s. 50128 (hand turning a textbook page) is more literal but has a sharp, central face, which is not ideal between protagonist photos.

title: Young man lays on a bed with a strong stomach ache
notes: A young man (dreadlocks, grey T-shirt) bends over the bed and collapses face-down onto it (8.8-10.0 s), then lies limp. His face stays hidden by hair and bedding throughout. No text (a small gold chain is visible). Dim grey-green tone; darken a little. Do not start before 8.2 s, where he is still clutching his stomach by the wall.

title: Portrait of a woman trying to sleep in her bed
notes: Top-down, dark bedroom: a short-black-haired person in a dark top lies on their back, staring blankly up at the ceiling (0.2-2.9 s and 5.0-6.5 s). They move a hand to the chest (~3.0 s) and close their eyes in a sigh (~4.0 s). CONCERN: the face fills much of the frame and is a woman's (androgynous short hair; dim light keeps it soft). Pillow at the right has a printed pattern, no text. Dark, usable as is. Same actor as st03 and st17/19. The literal men-staring-at-ceiling clips (48733, 48611) are Restricted. Alt 31414 shows a man in bed at night with a small face, but reads more as trying to sleep.

title: Young woman using her cell phone lying in her bed
notes: Dark, shot from behind the head: a person lying on their back holds a phone up with both hands and scrolls with a thumb. Only the top of the head and an upside-down chin show; short black hair, dark top. In this range the phone screen is a colourful, out-of-focus image with no legible text. Dark and moody, usable as is. Shares the clip with st19 (0.5-3.5 here, 4.0-9.0 there).

title: A young man wearing a hoodie studying at night in the library with a calculator
notes: Night study under a warm hanging lamp: a young man with curly hair in a cream hoodie reads and writes at a desk with an open book, a pen pot and a bookshelf behind. He pauses with the pen at his mouth and looks up as if thinking (~4 s). His face is visible (frontal, medium shot); not a protagonist-adjacent segment. BLUR: a partial word printed on the hoodie chest, and a book cover with a large '25' at the far left edge. Background spines are out of focus. A second person's hand enters at ~9 s (outside the range). Warm and dim, usable.

title: Young woman using her cell phone lying in her bed
notes: Later part of the st17 clip: same framing, still scrolling the phone held up (4.0-9.0 s); no overlap with st17. Around 6.5 s the screen shows app text ('Cuentacuentos'), which is acceptable because this segment is blurred under the centre subtitle. The phone drops out of frame after ~10.5 s.

title: Close up of a hand writing to do list on a yellow paper notebook
notes: Hand only, close-up of a spiral notebook: finishes writing a 'To do list' heading, puts the pen down on the page (~7.5 s), reaches away to a mug (8-9.5 s; a large out-of-focus hand passes by) and leaves the pen lying there. This reads as the plan stopping. Handwritten 'To do list' is legible but blurred under the centre subtitle. Bright daylight, so darken it. Only 4.3 s from the in-point to the clip end, so play at 0.95x for 4.5 s. Group C st62 uses this clip at 0.5-6.0 s; this range (6.0-10.3 s) does not overlap. If the editor wants no cross-group reuse, use alt 49918 (hand holding a highlighter, pausing over handwritten notes; female hands). Free calendar clips (2847 'MONEY' circle) show no hand; 17412, 38501, 17413 and 35903 are Restricted.

title: Scientist observing through a microscope
notes: PARTIAL match (lab equipment but no screens): over-the-shoulder from behind, a researcher in a lab coat and blue gloves looks into a microscope, with a test-tube rack on a white bench. Face not visible (back and side of the head). No brand legible on the microscope. BRIGHT and clean, so darken and cool it. Every lab clip with computer screens or brain scans checked (5644, 5664, 5665, 5643, 5852, 5839, 5634, 5850) is Restricted.

title: A young woman pedaling on a static bike
notes: Black-and-white on a black background: side close-up of legs and feet pedaling a stationary spin bike (0-1.4 s), then the camera tilts up to the thighs and a hand gripping the handlebar while she keeps pedaling (1.6-2.8 s). Face appears only after ~4.5 s, so stay before 4 s. No brand visible on the bike. Dark, usable as is. For legs only, 0.0-1.5 s at 0.8x gives 1.9 s, which is short for 2.3 s, so use the tilt. 14870 (feet on a fixed bike) is Restricted.

title: Man eats watching television on a rainy night
notes: PARTIAL match: the TV is off-screen, so there is no logo risk, but the documentary itself is not shown. Night living room with a lamp: a bearded man in a dark T-shirt sits in profile, calmly watching TV (off-screen right) while picking at takeout snacks. Face in profile, medium-wide. Unlabelled jar glass, no text. Dim and moody, usable. 26092 (same shoot, TV visible over his shoulder) is used by group C st55, and its screen shows an out-of-focus drama-like scene with people (possible copyrighted show). Other TV clips (9612 green-screen TV, 5993, 33335, 47911, 36423, 9252) are Restricted.

title: A young athlete woman pedaling on a stationary bike over a black background
notes: Black-and-white wide side view on black: a woman rides a stationary spin bike, full body small in the frame, steady pedaling. Face small in profile. No legible brand on the flywheel. Dark, usable as is. Different clip from st22 but the same shoot. If group B uses 50961 for st25 (right after the black card), use alt 50959.
